# Display snippets for docs/graphs.md

--8<-- [start:overview_import]
-import_from(graphs, [vertices, shortest_path, is_connected])

Main <- (
    G = [["a", "b"], ["b", "c"], ["a", "c"]],
    vertices(G, V),
    ++print(f"vertices: {V}"),
    shortest_path(G, "a", "c", P),
    ++print(f"Shortest path: {P}")
)
--8<-- [end:overview_import]

--8<-- [start:overview_module]
-import_module(graphs)

Main <- (
    G = [["a", "b"], ["b", "c"]],
    graphs.vertices(G, V),
    graphs.is_connected(G)
)
--8<-- [end:overview_module]

--8<-- [start:query_examples]
vertices([["a", "b"], ["b", "c"]], V)    % V = ["a", "b", "c"]
neighbors([["a", "b"], ["b", "c"]], "b", N)  % N = ["a", "c"]
degree([["a", "b"], ["b", "c"]], "b", D)     % D = 2
--8<-- [end:query_examples]

--8<-- [start:traversal_example]
breadth_first_nodes([["a", "b"], ["b", "c"], ["c", "d"]], "a", N)
# N = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
--8<-- [end:traversal_example]

--8<-- [start:pathfinding_examples]
# Enumerate all paths
find_path([["a", "b"], ["b", "c"], ["a", "c"]], "a", "c", P)
# P = ["a", "b", "c"]  then  P = ["a", "c"]

# Shortest path in a weighted graph
shortest_path([["a", "b", 1], ["b", "c", 2], ["a", "c", 10]], "a", "c", P)
# P = ["a", "b", "c"]

# Cost of a path
path_cost([["a", "b", 3], ["b", "c", 5]], ["a", "b", "c"], C)
# C = 8
--8<-- [end:pathfinding_examples]

--8<-- [start:component_examples]
connected_components([["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]], C)
# C = [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]]

topological_sort([["a", "b"], ["b", "c"], ["a", "c"]], O)
# O = ["a", "b", "c"]
--8<-- [end:component_examples]

--8<-- [start:tree_example]
min_spanning_tree([["a", "b", 1], ["b", "c", 2], ["a", "c", 4]], T, C)
# T = [["a", "b", 1], ["b", "c", 2]]   C = 3
--8<-- [end:tree_example]

--8<-- [start:transform_example]
reverse_edges([["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]], R)
# R = [["b", "a"], ["d", "c"]]
--8<-- [end:transform_example]
